items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog); webindia123; powercorridors.in
items.summary: CATCH-UP (never alerted): former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee posted on X condemning Dipke's detention — 'Abhijeet Dipke has been detained for holding the Indian National Flag... In Independent India, our youth are being detained for peacefully asserting their democratic rights' — calling the action 'nothing short of an undeclared Emergency' and 'the conduct of a fascist regime.' She named Das and Ranka too and added 'your Didi stands firmly with you... WAKE UP, INDIA!'
items.title: CATCH-UP: Mamata Banerjee condemns Dipke detention as 'undeclared Emergency'; 'your Didi stands firmly with you'

items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog, quoting @mkstalin verbatim); trendkia (live blog); powercorridors.in
items.summary: CATCH-UP (never alerted): DMK president M.K. Stalin posted on X Friday evening: 'Where is @abhijeet_dipke? Where is @neha_aisa? Detaining them without disclosing their whereabouts is blatantly illegal and deeply inhumane. The Union Government must release them immediately and stop suppressing peaceful protests... #GyaneshKumarMustGo.' Trendkia's live blog reports the same evening statement demanding prompt release and an end to muzzling non-violent demonstrations.
items.title: CATCH-UP: Stalin demands immediate release of Dipke and Neha Bora; 'blatantly illegal and deeply inhumane'

items.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor said in an X post that carrying the Tricolour while walking on a public street is not a crime and demanded an explanation from Delhi Police over CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's detention. No second outlet has carried this post yet.
items.title: 'Walking with Tiranga is not a crime': Shashi Tharoor questions Dipke's detention, demands police explanation

items.source_name: AISA (@aisa_official_ on X) via The Daily Jagran (live blog); trendkia (live blog)
items.summary: AISA posted on X: 'Where is @abhijeet_dipke? His family and associates have been given NO information about his whereabouts. AISA President Neha Bora was taken away in an unmarked car with blackened windows over an hour ago. Their whereabouts remain unknown. Delhi Police must answer!' Trendkia's live blog (independent, bylined) separately reports AISA's claim that Bora was taken from the Manglapuri Anti-Narcotics facility in a tinted-glass vehicle without legal-team access.
items.title: AISA: 'Where is Dipke?' — family has no info; Neha Bora 'taken away in an unmarked car with blackened windows'

items.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav posted on X (in Hindi) calling it 'a very serious matter' that there is no word on where detained Neha Bora has been taken at night, demanding police disclose her location, urging the National Commission for Women to take immediate cognizance of this 'extremely sensitive matter,' and demanding her immediate release. Earlier in the day he had posted 'Today is the day of Ekaranga versus Tiranga' (per webindia123). No second outlet has carried the NCW post yet.
items.title: Akhilesh Yadav demands disclosure of Neha Bora's whereabouts, urges NCW to intervene

items.summary: The Congress posted on X criticising the government over arrests during the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' demonstrations, alleging people were detained for hoisting the Tricolour — 'those who had not hoisted the national flag for 52 years after Independence were now arresting people for doing so' — expressing solidarity with the detained protesters and accusing the BJP-led government of undermining democracy and the right to vote. No second outlet has carried this post yet.
items.title: Congress (@INCIndia) slams Centre over Tiranga-march arrests, backs detainees
